datafield.subfield: "Edition of 100 copies"--Vamp & Tramp Booksellers' website, viewed on July 22, 2014.

"Be the change was designed and produced in a class taught by Bonnie Thompson Norman at The Windowpane Press. It was printed on a Vandercook SP 15 with hand set type and hand bound by Barbara Evans, Amy Larson, David Major, Martha Rothe, Stephanie Schwenger, Saeko Suzuki and Bonnie"--Colophon.

"Vertical concertina structure. Letterpress printed on a Vandercook SP15 and a 1926 Chandler & Price from handset type and a photoengraving. Handbound. Enclosed in a letterpress printed wrapper"--Vamp & Tramp Booksellers' website, viewed on July 22, 2014.

Panels handbound and sewn at each end with black thread. Verso of leaves decorated with images of paper dolls holding hands. Enclosed in a rectangular paper wrapper with openings on either end, printed with the title, press name, and illustrations.
